makeup_policy: If a student misses the Mid-Semester or Comprehensive Examination due to a genuine reason (serious medical causes leading to hospitalization (certified by doctor from BITS medical center), personal/family emergencies) there exists a provision to apply for make-up. Prior permission must be taken from the Instructor-in-Charge, before applying for make-up. Make-up decisions will be made on a case-by-case basis and only genuine cases as determined by the Departmental team will be considered. No Make-Up will be granted for quiz, assignments and Lab components.
